text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I want to present the golden bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I want to carve your name into history.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
May the true light shine upon you, forever 
and ever.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: May it shower down upon you—

text_block_list.name: Bouquet & Eye
text_block_list.text: Yaaaah!! Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa!? What crazy intensity! Was 
Bouquet always like that!?

text_block_list.name: Race Enthusiast
text_block_list.text:
I remember when she first debuted. She 
seemed like such a quiet girl, but—haha! 
...So, it's for her Trainer, huh.

text_block_list.name: Race Enthusiast
text_block_list.text: What a strong girl she is.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Win, win—! I'm definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Bouquet Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Go for it, Bouquet!" "Seize your dream!" 
"Run!" "Bring victory home to your 
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, I'll—!!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has conquered the match of the 
century! Curren Bouquetd'or...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Toppling the queen of the era, Almond Eye, 
she makes a magnificent leap straight to 
the pinnacle!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A fighting spirit ignited by a lovely 
flower! Bundling all those hopes together, 
Curren Bouquetd'or heads for the 
summit...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Goosebumpsâ! Because I've seen how hard 
you've been trying all this time...! 
...You're amazing, Bouquet-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Ai's Fan
text_block_list.text:
...! Losing is sad, but... Still—Ai-chan 
was totally the best!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, jeez! Come on!! Ughhh, I wanted to 
win! I wanted to win so badly!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"It's frustrating...! I'm so, so 
frustrated...!! I really am...! It stings 
so much—but...!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah, that was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Bouquet-chan—you really are incredible. 
...I definitely want to surpass you. Next 
time for sure!"

text_block_list.name: Bouquet Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Bouquet, congratulationsss!!" "Trainer, 
you did great too!!" "That was the 
ultimate victory!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Every... one—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(It feels as though all the light is 
gathering together—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's hopes, your dreams— they are 
what guided us all the way here!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you...! Thank you so very much—!
(WOOOOOOOOO...!!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

Turning the fans' feelings into power— she 
bloomed brilliantly into a magnificent 
flower, shining brighter than ever before.

Without a shadow of a doubt, she was the 
protagonist of the turf on that day.

Surely, her presence was etched into the 
hearts of everyone who bore witness to 
this day—
choice_data_list:
This is the radiance I wanted to dedicate 
to you...!

This is the radiance I wanted to dedicate 
to you...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, absolutely—and from me, from me 
as well...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—These cheers, this victory, this 
glory...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It's a single golden blossom!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I bind them together and offer them to 
you. Please, accept them!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: This golden bouquet is for you...!
—The next day.

The front page of the sports paper 
proclaimed with lively excitement:

"The battle of the century, centered 
around the queen of the era, Almond Eye, 
has begun—!"

“Together with Curren Bouquetd'or's 
radiance, she blossomed into a magnificent 
flower to be remembered for generations to 
come.”
